meta.topic: Jewelry and watch ownership: servicing, care and repair, insurance, resale, commissions and home safes
meta.fitsCatalog: Researched against the accessory-slot jewelry and watch products in src/engine/content/clothingcatalog.ts. Watches there include Timex, Casio, Casio G-SHOCK, Seiko, Fossil, Citizen, Tissot, Longines, Cartier, Frederique Constant, Tommy Hilfiger, Michael Kors and Philipp Plein. Jewelry there includes Pandora, Monica Vinader, Missoma, Thomas Sabo, Tiffany & Co., Tous, Newbridge Silverware and others. Mejuri and Swatch are not in the catalog, but the brief named them.

conventions.confirmed: true only when the figure was read on the publisher's own page or document on the read date. false when it came from a search-engine summary, a third party, or a blocked page.
conventions.taxIncluded: true or false when the page says so, or when the market's consumer price-display law settles it (UK and Ireland retail prices to consumers include VAT; Mexican consumer prices include IVA under LFPC art. 7 Bis). Otherwise null.
conventions.nulls: A figure that could not be read is null and carries a note. No number here is estimated or invented.

meta.method: Each page was fetched directly, by HTTP with HTML stripped or by pdftotext for PDFs. A page that refused the fetch (403) was looked up by web search, and any figure taken that way is confirmed:false.

watchService.intervalNote: Rolex recommends a service approximately every 10 years, depending on the model and how the watch is actually used.
watchService.priceNote: Rolex publishes no service price list. The price is quoted per watch by Rolex or an official Rolex jeweler.
watchService.note: rolex.com returned 403 to every fetch. The interval comes from a search summary restricted to rolex.com, which quoted it consistently across several Rolex pages.

watchService.intervalNote: 'we recommend that you have the water resistance checked once a year and a complete service performed every 5 to 8 years.' Every intervention carries a 24-month warranty.
watchService.batteryAdvice: When the battery is nearly flat, the seconds hand moves in 4-second jumps. OMEGA advises having it replaced at an authorised service centre without delay, because a leaking battery can damage the movement.

watchService.priceNote: OMEGA's own price page draws its table client-side, and the fetch returned only dashes. Third-party guides give official complete-service prices of roughly USD 600-950 for mechanical watches and USD 350-450 for quartz, but those are not OMEGA's page and are not recorded as figures here. For a UK figure from a named retailer, see fraserhart-omega below.

watchService.intervalNote: 'every five to six years, or at the first sign of irregularities, the TAG Heuer Customer Care team recommends a professional service at an official TAG Heuer service centre.' The warranty can extend to five years if the watch is registered.

watchService.basis: Suggested retail prices in USD, tax excluded, non-binding. Price list 2026-03. M1 = partial maintenance, M2 = complete service.
watchService.warranty: 24 months on the maintenance performed and the parts replaced.
watchService.includes: M1: diagnosis, dismantling, ultrasonic cleaning of case and bracelet, battery (quartz), new gaskets for water resistance, final control. M2: all of M1 plus a movement overhaul or replacement, oiling, regulation and wear parts.

watchService.basis: Suggested retail prices in GBP, VAT included, non-binding. Price list 2026-03.
Suggested retail prices in CAD, tax excluded, non-binding. Price list 2026-03.
watchService.note: The same URL pattern for IE, MX, FR and EU returned 404, so no TAG Heuer list for Ireland or Mexico was found.

watchService.intervalNote: 'we recommend that you have your watch serviced every 4 to 5 years by a Tissot Authorised Service Centre'. Tissot also advises a water-resistance check every year. Spare parts are guaranteed for at least 10 years after production ends, and up to 20 years for gold watches.

watchService.basis: Prices charged by the Swatch Group's official customer service centre in each country, also recommended to agreed third-party centres. Shipping is not included. Light service = battery or bracelet work at a minimum labour fee, parts extra, no warranty. Partial service = cleaning, new gaskets, battery, regulation, with 2 years' water-resistance warranty. Complete service = full movement overhaul, with 2 years' warranty on the movement too.

markets.note: On the UK page, battery replacement is not listed under light service. The touch-screen light service is shown as '-'.
The complete price for touch-screen watches was cut off in the fetched text, so it is null.

markets.warranty: 2 years on partial and complete. The light service has an asterisked note.
markets.note: The Mexican page calls the price list 'informativa' (indicative).

watchService.intervalNote: 'in general, we recommend having your watch serviced about every three years at an Authorized Seiko Service Center.' Seiko's caliber manuals say roughly every 3 to 4 years.

watchService.basis: Seiko Watch of America service center, movement overhaul retail prices by caliber series. Sales tax, shipping, handling and insurance are not included. The movement service includes the overhaul, needed movement parts, gaskets and a water test, a battery, ion cell or rechargeable cell (quartz), lubrication, timing, and ultrasonic cleaning of the case and band.

quartz.caliber: Analog battery or rechargeable battery powered

declinedEstimateFee.appliesTo: Seiko watches with MSRP of USD 1,500 or more, and any gold product, when the estimate is declined

watchService.note: These are Timex's own mail-in repair fees, sent with a USPS label. Problems in the first year are usually covered by the Timex Limited Warranty, but an $8 handling charge applies to each watch sent in.

'Need a new battery for your favorite Swatch? From now on, Swatch will replace it at no cost to you.' The battery is changed in corporate Swatch stores ('Energy for Life'). The page sets no price for authorised third-party retailers.

watchService.chain: Jewelry Repair Direct by Kay (Signet mail-in service)
watchService.includes: A new battery. On water-resistant watches it also includes a pressure test and reseal, and the watch is cleaned.
watchService.note: This is Kay's mail-in price, read from the shop's own product feed. Kay's in-store battery price is not published on kay.com, which says to book in store. Third-party sites quote about $13-20 in store, but that is not confirmed.
Walmart publishes no watch-battery fitting price. Walmart's own pages sell batteries and DIY kits. Third-party sources disagree on whether stores still fit batteries.

These are Timpson's repair-by-post prices, which include insured return postage. Timpson does not publish an in-store battery price online. Secondary sources say about £10-20, but that is not confirmed. timpson.co.uk returned 403, so these figures come from search summaries of Timpson's own brand pages.

Battery replacement without reseal, premium brands

watchService.intervalNote: 'Most watch manufacturers recommend a complete service at regular intervals, with every five to seven years considered optimal.' Battery replacement is not a same-day service.

jewelryCare.note: 'Our cleaning and inspection service is available and free for all your jewelry—whether you purchased it at Zales or not!' Book in store or walk in. Under Zales's Lifetime Diamond Commitment, the diamond must be inspected every six months, but that requirement comes from a search summary and was not read on this page.

jewelryCare.basis: The 'typical cost without plan' column on Zales's Lifetime Protection Plan page. With the plan, every service is 'INCLUDED'. The plan's price depends on the item's original price, and no tiers are published.

rows.service: Ring sizing (up or down two sizes under the plan)

jewelryCare.note: 'open: true' means the page shows the price with a trailing '+'.
Read from the shop's own product feed (products.json). A 0.00 price means the item is quoted after inspection, so those are recorded as null.

Pandora cleans authentic Pandora jewellery for free. Basic cleaning is done in selected stores, and deep cleaning in Pandora Care Centers. Pandora does not offer official ring resizing. All of this comes from a search summary, because pandora.net returned 403.
The site-wide banner reads 'Complimentary Jewelry Cleaning at Stores'.

jewelryCare.cleaning: Free jewellery cleaning in store (FAQ). Rings bought online are resized free, which adds about 4-7 business days.

carePlan.name: Professional Care Plan
carePlan.includes: Clean and inspect; refinish and polish; basic re-shaping; rhodium plating once a year; ring resizing once a year; tightening and resetting stones (not supplying them); re-tipping claws/prongs (not rebuilding them); chain or bracelet soldering, including shortening; clasp repair or replacement; pendant bail repair; tennis bracelet links; earring posts and butterflies.
carePlan.note: The $0-100 bracket shows '-'. The rows were read from the PDF flyer linked on the plan page, and any rows above $20,000 were not captured.

rings.halfShankFrom: from 750, depending on weight and metal

claws.note: A new head is estimated when more than 50% of the claws need retipping.

rows.service: Ring clean & polish (rhodium for white gold), silver

jewelryCare.note: The estimate is free, online or in store. These figures come from a search summary, because the pages returned 403 to a direct fetch.

jewelryCare.leadTime: About 6 weeks to quote an estimate price, then 8 weeks after the customer goes ahead. Some repairs are done at Fraser Hart's workshop in Glasgow.

jewelryCare.note: Priced by how many sizes the ring changes. Not a same-day service. These figures come from a search summary, because the jewellery-workshop page returned 403. The same site's watch-workshop page did fetch and is confirmed above.
Timpson resizes rings and repairs chains with a 1-year warranty, but publishes no prices. It quotes in shop.

No Pandora Mexico service page was found. Free in-store cleaning is reported only on social media. Pandora Mexico sells its jewellery-care kit (A002) at MXN 899 according to a search summary, which is unconfirmed.

insurance.appliesTo: Theft of jewelry, at home or away. For other perils such as fire or water, jewelry can be covered up to full replacement value within the contents limit.
insurance.deductible: The renters deductible, chosen between $250 and $2,500, is taken off before the $1,500 sublimit applies.
insurance.note: The same $1,500 special limit for theft of jewelry, watches, furs and precious stones is the ISO HO 00 03 form default. That comes from a search summary of trade sources and is unconfirmed.

publishedAverage.impliedNote: 9.46 x 12 / 90.37. This is arithmetic on Lemonade's two published averages, not a rate Lemonade quotes.

insurance.example: A watch worth $5,000 costs 'around $5/month' to schedule.
insurance.coverage: Full replacement value with no deductible. It also covers loss and mysterious disappearance.
insurance.appraisal: A receipt is enough for pieces owned less than five years. Over five years, or without a receipt, an appraisal is needed.

insurance.rateNote: 'typically costs about 1–2% of your jewelry's value each year.' The exact rate depends on the wearer's residential location (historical losses) and the deductible.
insurance.deductible: The customer chooses, starting at $0. A higher deductible lowers the premium.
insurance.appraisal: Jewelers Mutual recommends updating the appraisal every two years.
insurance.discounts: Depending on the state, discounts may apply for a home security system, for keeping jewelry in a safe deposit box, or for a Gem ID inscription.

insurance.appliesTo: All jewelry, including watches, on standard home, condo and tenant policies. The enhanced home package raises the limit to $15,000.
insurance.scheduledOption: Personal Valuables Coverage. Rings up to $20,000 need no appraisal (up to $50,000 for Private Client Advisor customers). Above $20,000, an appraisal is required.

insurance.note: The customer chooses the jewellery and watch limit. With most insurers, jewellery is capped at $6,000 or less per claim. Square One recommends revisiting appraisals at least every three years. A search summary said $6,000 of cover costs about $3.35/month, but that figure was not on the page that was read, so it is unconfirmed and not recorded as a figure.

Any item worth more than £2,500 must be specified. Valuables cover can be raised above £10,000 for a fee. Online, up to £50,000 of personal belongings and up to £20,000 of valuables can be specified. Personal Belongings cover adds accidental damage, loss and theft worldwide.
The page states a single-item limit only for Gold (£5,000). Its table also shows £2,000 figures for the other tiers, but the fetched text does not label them, so Bronze and Silver are left null.

insurance.specifiedItems: Jewellery, watches, cameras and bicycles can be specified individually at a stated amount.

rules.rule: Contents cover: jewellery, gold and silverware, costume jewellery, watches, collections and art
rules.limit: 335 UMA per article or set, and in total no more than 10% of the contents sum insured

rules.rule: Separate 'C. Joyería' cover: robbery of jewellery, gold/silverware, watches and furs worth more than 335 UMA each, inside the home
rules.perils: Robbery with violence that leaves visible marks, or assault
rules.valuation: Replacement value supported by an appraisal (avalúo) and/or invoice. Without one, the payout is capped at 335 UMA per article or set.

rules.rule: 'B. Artículos en tránsito': personal items carried outside the home, including watches

insurance.approxNote: approxMXN2026 = UMA count x 117.31. That is arithmetic on the 2026 UMA, not a figure GNP prints.
insurance.note: These are GNP's general conditions document dated August 2024. Claims also need visual proof (photo or video) of the item.
Itemized jewelry described as 'in-vault' must be kept in a bank vault, and a home safe does not count. This comes from a search summary of a third-party agency blog and is unconfirmed.

resale.note: 'might lend as little as 15% or as much as 60% of the item's resale value.' The loan is based on the item's value, condition and resale potential, and there is no credit check.

resale.regulator: Texas Office of Consumer Credit Commissioner
resale.note: These are maximum rates for one-month loans. Any pawn service charge above $15 is refundable. Brackets adjust every 1 July with the CPI. Texas is one state's law and is used here as a real example.

resale.interestMethod: Charged daily: the monthly rate x 12 / 365.25. The first 28 days are a minimum charge. Partial pay-downs are allowed, and each payment restarts a 6-month contract.
resale.tableNote: This table sits in an FAQ section of the page about the switch to daily interest and may be older. The current representative example (125.9% a year, about 10.49% a month) and the worked example in the same FAQ (10.49%) do not match its 9.99% top row. A search summary gave a newer ladder: £10-1,500 at 10.49%, £1,501-3,500 at 9.49%, £3,501-5,000 at 9.00%, £5,001-7,500 at 8.00%, £7,501-10,000 at 7.00%, £10,001-15,000 at 6.00%, £15,001-50,000 at 5.00%, over £50,000 at 4.00%. That ladder was not seen on the page and is unconfirmed.
resale.unsoldItems: Unredeemed items are auctioned. Any surplus above the loan plus interest is paid to the customer.

resale.note: Pawnbrokers must be licensed by the CCPC, and rates and fees must be displayed on the premises. Typical fees are the pawn ticket, valuation and inspection of the sales book. An unredeemed item can be sold only at auction by a licensed auctioneer, and the customer can claim any surplus. A search summary named three licensed pawnbrokers (John Brereton, Kearns, Carthy's) and a typical 2-3% a month over 4 months and 7 days, but that is unconfirmed.

resale.status: A strike closed the branches from 1 Oct 2025. It ended on 30 Sep 2026, and branches reopen on 7 Oct 2026 with 45 days free of interest. Monte de Piedad's own page shows the reopening countdown and the extended sale dates, and the dates come from a search summary of press reports.
resale.note: The rates PDF returned 403, so its figures come from a search summary of that PDF. The status page did fetch.

resale.formula: payout per gram = spot price per troy oz / 31.103 x assumed purity x payout %

publishedExample.purityNote: The dealer pays on average assay purity, not the stamp. For example, 14K assays at 53.5-58.5%, so it uses 56%. There are no processing fees, and metal is weighed on a gram scale, not assayed.
publishedExample.processingTime: Gold about 2 weeks and silver about 8 weeks (delayed by market conditions).

resale.note: This dealer works near refinery rates. Payout percentages by channel (pawn shops 40-70% of spot, cash-for-gold 50-75%, jewellers 70-85%, online buyers 70-90%, refiners 90-98%) appear only in search summaries of calculator sites and are unconfirmed.

therealreal.com returned 403. Its own marketing pages, as summarised by search, say consignors earn up to 75% on designer watches and vintage jewellery, up to 85% on Cartier watches and up to 90% on Rolex, with a 5% bonus for site credit. Third-party guides describe price-tiered rates, but the tier table was not read.

The help article is rendered client-side and could not be read. A search summary said 30% commission up to $3,000 and 15% on the portion above, and a 10% bonus for store credit or a Neiman Marcus gift card on buyouts, but this is unconfirmed.

resale.process: Watchfinder sends an estimate within 48 hours, then inspects the watch at its service centre and makes a final offer valid for up to 5 days. A minimum servicing fee applies to every sale and is shown at the initial quotation. No servicing fee is charged on a part-exchange unless manufacturer repairs or parts are needed. On consignment, the seller gets the sale price minus the commission shown on the Consignment Summary, with an agreed minimum sales price.
resale.note: A search summary gave a $60 minimum servicing fee, but the help page that was read states no amount.
watchcharts.com returned 403, so these come from search summaries of its pages. No published second-hand values were found for Pandora, Mejuri or fashion-brand watches.

commissions.designFeeNote: 'Available Computer-Aided Design (CAD) services include a non-refundable fee and two complimentary revisions.' The amount is not stated.
commissions.quoteValidity: Two weeks after the design is approved and paid for. After that, pricing may change.
commissions.cancellation: Once the design is approved and paid for, no cancellations or changes are accepted.

commissions.terms: The quote is complimentary and itemised. Quotes are valid for 5 business days because market prices move. Custom orders are non-refundable, non-exchangeable and cannot be cancelled. Custom rings are excluded from the free 1-year resize, and resizing them is charged.

commissions.designDepositNote: Taken after the first consultation and deducted from the final quote if the customer goes ahead. Highly bespoke CAD work may carry a separate design charge, agreed in advance.
commissions.rushNote: Pieces needed in under 8 weeks may carry extra fees for overtime.

commissions.note: Design time is charged at £35 an hour and averages 3 hours. Making is materials plus time at £35 an hour.

commissions.deposit: 50% once the final design is agreed

commissions.cadFeeNote: Fully redeemable against the ring. No changes are accepted once the CAD is approved.

rows.basis: per item, one or both sides
per item, one or both sides. Online engraving is mechanical, and in-store engraving is laser.

commissions.note: Pandora's help centre renders client-side and returned an empty page. These figures come from search summaries. Canada has a matching help article whose price was not read.

Engraving on engravable pieces is reported as complimentary, up to 10 characters on the bar bracelet and 7 on the slim signet. Engraved items cannot be returned. This comes from a search summary and was not seen on Mejuri's page.

safes.note: Prices are paired from the search-results listing. Some show a 'Was' price, so they are sale prices on the read date.

safes.rule: UK insurers typically cover valuables kept in a safe at about 10 times its cash rating. They usually want the safe fixed to the floor or wall, and may ask for the make, model, cash rating or Eurograde, fixing and lock type. Fire safes generally carry no cash rating that insurers accept.
safes.note: This is a retailer's guide, not an insurer's policy wording, and it says ratios vary by insurer. No named UK insurer's value threshold for requiring a safe was found.
Discounts are listed for a home security system, a safe deposit box and a Gem ID inscription. A home safe is not named. The size of the discount is not published.

On the outdoor-theft cover, if a discount was given for anti-theft security measures and those measures were not in place at the time of the loss, the payout is cut by the same proportion as the discount. This clause sits under the outdoor-theft cover in the general conditions, and no specific safe discount figure is given.
